title: lathyrus maritimus f. albiflorus
intro: Lathyrus maritimus f. albiflorus, commonly known as the White Sea Pea, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus maritimus f. albiflorus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions like arthritis and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
